watches.name: Bespoke “Watch Reservation”
watches.description: The Intaglio 38 Tonneau Edition is an elegant yet robust option for a wide range of wrists. The curved profile and lugs enables it to be extremely wearable, with the midcase height measuring just 6mm. The box-domed sapphire crystal also sets off the handmade Intaglio dial in a most dramatic way, showcasing the distinctive tactile surface. With a water resistance rating of 20 ATM, the 38 Tonneau is an ideal balance of a tool and dress watch. Produced in small batches, our Intaglio dials are all patinated, engraved, and hand-finished in our California studio using premium metals including brass, sterling silver, copper, or gold alloy. The result is a special dial that feels equally precious and distinctive, akin to that of a handmade piece of pottery. Each dial and resulting timepiece is a unique and personal heirloom. SPECIFICATIONS: 316L Stainless Case, radial brushed with polished chamfers Measures 38mm x 46mm x 10mm (12mm total height), 20mm lugs Box Dome Sapphire Crystal with 5 layers of interior UV Coating Engraved Exhibition Display Back Threaded & Engraved Screwdown Crown Hand-Finished Engraved Dial with Unique Hand-Finishing & Patina Fitted with a Handmade Leather Strap in Premium Bridle Leather Powered by a 25-Jewel Swiss Automatic Movement (ETA 2824-2), regulated to +/- 4-6 seconds per day 20 ATM Water Resistance Rating TERMS & DELIVERY: Please allow 3-4 weeks for assembly & shipping. watches.name: Intaglio 38 Tonneau: “Moderna” Sage & Brass Dial
watches.description: The Intaglio 38 Tonneau Edition is an elegant yet robust option for a wide range of wrists. The curved profile and lugs enables it to be extremely wearable, with the midcase height measuring just 6mm. The box-domed sapphire crystal also sets off the handmade Intaglio dial in a most dramatic way, showcasing the distinctive tactile surface. With a water resistance rating of 20 ATM, the 38 Tonneau is an ideal balance of a tool and dress watch. Produced in small batches, our Intaglio dials are all patinated, engraved, and hand-finished in our California studio using premium metals including brass, sterling silver, copper, or gold alloy. The result is a special dial that feels equally precious and distinctive, akin to that of a handmade piece of pottery. Each dial and resulting timepiece is a unique and personal heirloom. SPECIFICATIONS: 316L Stainless Case, radial brushed with polished chamfers Measures 38mm x 46mm x 10mm (12mm total height), 20mm lugs Box Dome Sapphire Crystal with 5 layers of interior UV Coating Engraved Exhibition Display Back Threaded & Engraved Screwdown Crown Hand-Finished Engraved Dial with Unique Hand-Finishing & Patina Fitted with a Handmade Leather Strap in Premium Bridle Leather Powered by a 25-Jewel Swiss Automatic Movement (ETA 2824-2), regulated to +/- 4-6 seconds per day 20 ATM Water Resistance Rating TERMS & DELIVERY: Please allow 3-4 weeks for assembly & shipping.
